text: Renée Butler / Greg Leonard / Marlboro Event Marketing
Marlboro Team Penske and Indy Car Racing continue to be key promotion and entertainment vehicles. We are here
to assist your section office in getting the most out of the Grand Prix in Nazareth. Please be aware of the following
key elements as the start date for the promotional activities in the Nazareth markets are rapidly approaching.
A 250 guest hospitality tent is available for your section office to utilize throughout the race weekend. This provides
an excellent business building opportunity to extend relationships with key customers.
Tracy, your office is responsible for ticket organization, catering coordination and tent decoration. The hospitality
materials being shipped to your warehouse are for the tent. Some of the retail materials should be set aside to
decorate the tent. The remaining materials should be placed in your markets.
Unlike last year, Marlboro Team Penske will not host any guests in the hospitality tent. As such, there is no need to
increase your food and beverage orders above what is required for your guests.
Using the attached form, please list the individuals from your top ten accounts who will be attending the race,
including name, title and affiliation. Please MS Mail the completed form to Renée Butler by April 19, 1996.
